title: Auto Transport for Dealers
subtitle: We handle the logistics so you can focus on selling. From auction pickups to dealer trades, Y7 moves your inventory reliably and on time.

benefits.title: Volume Pricing
benefits.desc: Competitive rates for high-volume dealer accounts. The more you ship, the more you save.

benefits.title: Auction Pickups
benefits.desc: Same-day dispatch from Copart, IAA, Manheim, and ADESA. Gate pass coordination included.

benefits.title: Dealer-to-Dealer Trades
benefits.desc: Fast transport between dealerships. One point of contact for all your trade moves.

benefits.title: Dedicated Dispatch
benefits.desc: Your own dispatch coordinator who knows your routes, your timeline, and your preferences.

benefits.title: Central Dispatch Integration
benefits.desc: 90% of our loads go through Central Dispatch. Status updates at every stage via portal.

benefits.title: Flexible Payment
benefits.desc: Net-15 terms, ACH, and invoice-based billing designed for dealer operations.

models.title: Broker-Paid Carrier
models.desc: Y7 handles all carrier payments. Higher service fee but zero hassle — you never deal with carrier payment logistics, BOL disputes, or COD coordination.

models.title: Direct Carrier Payment (COD)
models.desc: Dealer pays carrier at delivery. Lower service fee but you handle BOL inspection and payment at the door. Best for experienced dealers with dock staff.
